# T002 — Python 3.12 metadata and instructions

## Summary

Declared Python >=3.12 and documented a working compile/test path using the installed Python 3.12 and uv. Pricing behavior and the seven tests are unchanged.

## Changes (files and why)

- `pyproject.toml`: raise `requires-python` from `>=3.10` to `>=3.12`.
- `README.md`: replace the non-working bare-`python`/system-pip instructions with explicit Python 3.12 compilation and an isolated uv test run using `requirements.txt`.
- `pricing.py`, `requirements.txt`, and `test_pricing.py` were not changed. Existing CRLF line endings in edited files were preserved.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

- No source compatibility fix is needed: the Python 3.12 baseline compiled and passed six tests (`assessment.md`, Build, test and CI); T001 added a passing characterization test (`progress/T001.md`). Keep current pricing behavior, formatting, and dependency specification.
- This environment has `/usr/bin/python3.12` and uv, but no bare system `python` or system pytest (`assessment.md`, Build, test and CI). The README's commands were run successfully here; uv supplies `python` within its isolated environment.

## Validation (commands and results)

- README instructions verified, both exit 0: `python3.12 -m compileall -q pricing.py test_pricing.py`; `uv run --no-project --python /usr/bin/python3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m pytest` (7 passed).
- Exact build gate, exit 0: `TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=.modernization-scratch/pycache python3.12 -m compileall -q pricing.py test_pricing.py`
- Exact full test gate, exit 0: `mkdir -p .modernization-scratch/T002 && TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=.modernization-scratch/pycache UV_CACHE_DIR=.modernization-scratch/uv-cache uv run --no-project --python /usr/bin/python3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m pytest -rA --junitxml=.modernization-scratch/T002/pytest.xml`
- JUnit `.modernization-scratch/T002/pytest.xml`: 7 passed / 0 failed / 0 errors / 0 skipped, counted from seven `<testcase>` elements. Baseline in assessment: 6 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped; T001: 7 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped. No lost tests or regressions. No lint gate configured.

## Follow-ups and risks

- `pytest>=7` remains unbounded as before; future dependency resolution can drift. Raw results/caches stay in locally excluded `.modernization-scratch/`; no external test services needed.
